import numpy as np


def forecast(train_series, history_windows, feature_cols, target_col, input_len, output_len):
    t_idx = feature_cols.index(target_col)
    w_idx = feature_cols.index("Wspd")
    # Estimate expected power based on recent average wind speed
    avg_wspd = np.mean(history_windows[:, -24:, w_idx], axis=1)

    last_val = history_windows[:, -1, t_idx][:, None]
